name: Yuukaku ni Urareta Ore no Kanojo
original_name: 遊廓に売られた俺の彼女
source:
A tale of love and (right before your eyes) loss!
In a historical setting you meet a beautiful Kendo girl and fall in love.
Your feelings are requited and the two of your enjoy your time together.

But... she is sold to the red light district and forced to service other men.
The only thing you can do is, be near her... working at the same establishment
and watching as she bit by bit changes right before your very own eyes...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE195414.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一段爱情与失去的故事，而失去就发生在你的眼前！在历史背景下，你遇到一位美丽的剑道少女，爱上了她。她也回应了你的心意，两人一同度过幸福时光。

然而……她被卖进了花街，被迫接待其他男人。你唯一能做的，就是留在她身边……在同一家店工作，眼睁睁看着她一点一点地改变……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE195414.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
